description: This Java source file defines the `X509AuthProvider` class, which extends `CredentialsApiAuthProvider`. It implements an authentication provider for verifying X.509 certificates using Hono's Credentials API. The class initializes with configuration, creates credentials from device-provided info, and performs credential validation.

classes.name: X509AuthProvider
classes.description: A class providing authentication through X.509 certificates by verifying credentials against Hono's Credentials API.

methods.name: X509AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with dependencies like credentials client factory, configuration, and tracer.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Creates credentials from device-provided JSON info, extracting tenant ID and subject DN, or returning null if missing.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Validates credentials by creating a `Device` object with tenant ID and device ID, returning a succeeded future.
